notes: *neither ... nor*: the present לֹא is itself what the opening correlative says and takes it, the coordinating waw taking the closing connective (rule 14); the clause-initial waw is unrepresented for want of a written connective.

The *of* of *a woman of a sorrowful spirit* goes to the construct קְשַׁת as the word stating what the recast attributive phrase contributes (rule 33), not to the rectum under rule 19; the competing reading is named in the unit note.
*strong drink* heads on *drink*; the competing head *strong* is named in the unit note under rule 31.
